intro.text: Brackets need Shift as well: ( is Shift and 9, ) is Shift and 0. Your right ring and little fingers reach up.
intro.tip: Brackets come in pairs – always close the one you open.

steps.title: Meet open bracket and close bracket
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: The museum (which opened last year) was busy. Bring a drink (water is best) and a coat.
Our cat (called Pickle) loves boxes. The test (only ten minutes) went well!
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out – trust your fingers!
